research_question: Do GLP-1 receptor agonists reduce major adverse cardiovascular events in adults with type 2 diabetes?
queries: GLP-1 receptor agonist cardiovascular outcomes type 2 diabetes

records.title: Major adverse cardiovascular events in type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial of a GLP-1 receptor agonist
records.abstract: In this randomized trial, adults with type 2 diabetes receiving the GLP-1 receptor agonist showed fewer major adverse cardiovascular events than placebo.

records.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists and major adverse cardiovascular events in type 2 diabetes: a meta-analysis of randomized trial data
records.abstract: This meta-analysis pools randomized trials of GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, liraglutide) and estimates effects on major adverse cardiovascular events, trial-level cardiovascular outcomes, and cardiovascular safety in type 2 diabetes.

records.title: Cardiovascular outcomes with GLP-1 receptor agonists in type 2 diabetes: pooled randomized trial analysis of major events
records.abstract: Pooled analysis of randomized trials reporting cardiovascular outcomes for GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy in adults with type 2 diabetes, including MACE endpoints, major adverse cardiovascular events, and cardiovascular safety.

records.title: Incretin therapy and cardiovascular safety in type 2 diabetes: adverse outcomes from randomized trials of GLP-1 receptor agonists
records.abstract: Review of randomized trial evidence on incretin therapy cardiovascular safety, covering GLP-1 receptor agonist outcomes and major adverse cardiovascular events in type 2 diabetes.

records.title: Soil microbiome diversity under long-term organic fertilization
records.abstract: We surveyed soil microbiome diversity across fertilization regimes in temperate cropland plots.
